SELECT -- 邀请表的基础字段 inv.id, inv.work_id, inv.product_title, inv.product_description, inv.model_source, inv.cooperation_content, inv.keywords, inv.is_batch_production, inv.proofing_quantity, inv.delivery_limit_hours, inv.cancel_time_limit, inv.quoted_price, inv.quoted_period_days, inv.is_quote_batch_plan, inv.quote_submit_at, inv.status, inv.created_at, inv.updated_at, inv.inviter_user_id, inv.invitee_user_id, inv.draw_number,
-- 关联查询【发起人】的用户信息 inviter.nick_name AS inviter_nick_name, inviter.avatar AS inviter_avatar FROM sd_proofing_invitations inv LEFT JOIN -- 关联用户表，获取【发起人】的信息 sys_user inviter ON inv.inviter_user_id = inviter.user_id WHERE -- 查询条件：我是【被邀约人】 inv.invitee_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY inv.created_at DESC

-- 关联查询【被邀约人】的用户信息 invitee.nick_name AS invitee_nick_name, invitee.avatar AS invitee_avatar FROM sd_proofing_invitations inv LEFT JOIN -- 关联用户表，获取【被邀约人】的信息 sys_user invitee ON inv.invitee_user_id = invitee.user_id WHERE -- 查询条件：我是【发起人】 inv.inviter_user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY inv.created_at DESC
